dialogue.text:
Even in this seemingly quiet library,
there is no guarantee of safety.
The night before the Honkai Eruption, I couldn't sleep...
14:07:47. [Houkai] Eruption occurred at Chiba Academy. Survival probability – 0.000000001%.
Beep, beep... The number you are calling is currently out of range. Please call later again.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: I'm Kiana. I'm currently in the Far Eastern region of Nagazora, Chiba Academy. You must be heading to this eruption site right now. Just know that I will definitely find you, no matter where you go!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Phew... I said what I wanted to say. I never thought the eruption would happen so suddenly. It seems quite small, but its zone is the entire Chiba Academy.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Now I need to find the target before Schicksal arrives. This time I won't let you escape!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Zombies infected by the Houkai have appeared... Luckily, I prepared my weapons in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Weapon check complete, ammo is in place... Though I don't know how long this old thing will last.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Well~ Following the plan, first I need to get out of this library. And of course, zombies are blocking the way...

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: People infected and mutated by the Houkai... They've lost their feelings and consciousness. Just like walking dead, such pitiful creatures.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Sorry, even so, this lady won't show mercy. At least as compensation, rest in peace.
